title: Kenworth T909 5 post Road Train Heavy Duty Custom Built FUPS Bullbar #12
description: Kenworth T909 FUPS 5 post hi-tensile polished aluminium heavy duty Bullbar, 100m diameter pipe with 100mm wide heavy duty box uprights, Cow Catcher to base of Bullbar on extended uprights, 4 additional uprights to lower bar. Outer side contour plates. Reversable Aluminium Road Train signs plus Canvas Oversize sign. Chrome eye bolts and colour coded hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin and powder coated front tow pin plate, Hella LED Indicator repeaters and daytime running lights in outer uprights. 2 additional support gussets between main channel and the first pipe plus 50x5mm flat bar on the top of the channel for additional protection. Driving light mounts fitted to customer specs. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
